title: Rav Acha bar Ravina

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bekhorot 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.50a.7), but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “son of Rava,” as explained in the entry Rav Acha bar Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Acha son of Ravina as the recipient of Rav Ashi’s money. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=347&lang=en) cites this transaction under the same name. Hyman proposes son of Rava.
